title: Parity of the Quadratic Polynomial f(x) = x^2 + 1
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether the function f(x) = x^2 + 1 is even, odd, or neither, and justify your answer.

steps.title: Substitute -x into the Formula
steps.explanation: Replace x with -x in the polynomial f(x) = x^2 + 1.
steps.why: Parity is tested by comparing f(-x) with f(x).

steps.title: Simplify the Squared Term
steps.explanation: Since (-x)^2 = x^2 for all real numbers x, the expression simplifies back to x^2 + 1 = f(x).
steps.why: Even powers of real numbers are invariant under sign reversal.

steps.title: Conclude Function Parity
steps.explanation: Because f(-x) = f(x) for all x in R, f(x) = x^2 + 1 is an even function.
steps.why: A polynomial containing only even powers of x (here x^2 and x^0) is always an even function.
